t: The Key-Value Rosetta Stone: Zipping Python and HTML
s: The article proposes that key-value pairs are a universal abstraction unifying concepts like Python arguments and HTML attributes, leading to simpler, AI-editable code by reducing the complexity of web development stacks.
sub: Unifying Python arguments and HTML attributes as key-value pairs.
Leveraging HTMX to extend HTML attributes and reduce JavaScript dependency.
Simplifying web development by sending HTML fragments over the wire instead of JSON.
The philosophical underpinning of key-value abstraction for AI comprehension.
